title: EventEnvelope
description: Common envelope for every Winkey event. `event_id` is also sent as the `Nats-Msg-Id` header so JetStream de-duplicates retries.

type.description: Equals the NATS subject for persistent events.

version.description: Schema version of `data`. Breaking changes bump it; consumers ignore versions they do not know.

traceparent.description: W3C trace context for OpenTelemetry propagation.
